text:
Evelyn (People Ops): Quick heads up 12:30 drop-off for Kelsey9s guest + an extra box marked 'event supplies'. Front desk says they've already taken custody. Can someone confirm storage and badge name?

Sam (Front Desk): Logged as PKG-777 (box) and PKG-778 (tote). Currently on cart by door. Guest name on manifest: K. Alvarez but calendar shows 'Kelsey 6 partner chat'. Which name should we badge?

Andrea: Badge them as 'Kelsey Alvarez (Guest of Kelsey)'. Also please add allergy note: "peanuts".

Evelyn (People Ops): Good catch. I'll make a sticky for 'ALLERGY: peanuts' and print a one-time badge with that label. Also please don't place the box near the coffee station in case crumbs.

PackageBot: PKG-778 scanned at 12:17 by courier. Photo attached: pkg_1832461179.jpg. Delivery note: "left at front desk per client".

Sam (Front Desk): Small hiccup 47E 4E6 4E6 4E6 48A 495 64F: badge printer jammed when I tried to print the first badge. Trying manual badge now.

Devon (Facilities): I can pop by with a spare label printer in 5. If Sam needs me to clear jam I can.

Kelsey: I'm running late, guests are early (sorry!). If badge printing takes long tell them to check in and I'll come get them. Also the extra box is event swag 389 but fragile. Please handle as fragile.

Sam (Front Desk): Cleared jam, printed temporary badge. Guest checked in at 12:24 as 'K. Alvarez'. I added "peanut allergy" note to the form and stuck fragile sticker on PKG-777. Cart moved to locker C3.

Evelyn (People Ops): Thank you Sam & Devon. Kelsey 3B5 64C when you arrive, drop by front desk for the signed guest form. We'll keep swag in C3.

Kelsey: On my way. If anyone wants some swag leftovers after the meeting DM me. :tada:

Andrea: FYI there's only one hotdesk available by studio A. Kelsey, would you like us to reserve it for your guest?

Kelsey: Yes please reserve the hotdesk. Guest will sit there for the hour.

Sam (Front Desk): Hotdesk reserved and labeled "GUEST - K. Alvarez". All set.

Evelyn (People Ops): Smooth. Appreciate the quick responses team. :white_check_mark:
